en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.617 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:

"Whoever takes their prayer lightly is not of me; by Allah (swt), they will not come to my Hawdh (on the Day of Judgment). By Allah (swt), whoever drinks intoxicants is not of me; by Allah (swt), they will not come to my Hawdh (Pond); no, by Allah (swt)."
